# Rectangle

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Generate a rectangle GeoJSON geometry from a center point and dimensions in kilometers.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/rectangle",
  "type": "RectangleOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/rectangle').par.center` (an input) and `op('/rectangle').out.feature` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.center`, `out.feature`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `center` | `Point2DField` | `[-74.006,40.7128]` |
| `altitude` | `NumberField` | `0` |
| `width` | `NumberField` | `10` |
| `height` | `NumberField` | `10` |
| `properties` | `DataField` | `[]` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Name | Type |
|------|------|
| `feature` | `GeoJsonField` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->
